answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and proves membership in a Semaphore-style tree, while a committed epoch polynomial binds its rate-limit credentials. A message-specific nullifier permits only the allowed number of messages per epoch; duplicate use exposes Shamir secret shares that reconstruct the agent’s private key, enabling verification and instantaneous collateral slashing. The wharf, hollow, and island are merely distinct message contexts: changing context cannot evade the same epoch limit.
